notes.title: Challenge Design Revised!
notes.content:
The demo has seen an update, where the design philosophy of the challenges has seen some severe changes. This means:

[list]
[*] Each room is now hand crafted with care, for a more engaging experience, which makes each room feel like a little action-puzzle you need to solve.
[*] Enemies has been redesigned to play more distinct roles from eachother, making each of them stand out more and enabling players to become more aware of their patterns.
[*] Added a new enemy in the demo as it was fulfilling a much needed role when looking at the challenges of each room. 
[*] Added a new form of trap that players need to avoid while engaged in combat.
[*] Damage of enemies has been increased, while their health has decreased, for more intense battles, that are more punishing, but let's you move on quicker when doing things right.
[*] Experience gained from killing monsters has increased, to allow for quicker leveling. 
[*] Turned down the amount of beginning rune slots
[*] Rune slots now costs more to buy and they cost a varying amount depending on how many you've already unlocked.
[*] Arcane Whiskers and Mouse Tokens drops more frequent.
[/list] 

All in all the demo should now be filled with more varied content for players to enjoy. It should lean more into the quick plays of roguelites, where you die continuously, gain upgrades and get further. The loop between each run should be tighter, encouraging players to learn enemy patterns, become more powerful etc. to defeat the demo.

Hope that this all gives you a better game experience.

Happy Gaming
- Mathias Zillo
Zillo Games

notes.title: Corrupted Runes have entered the Whiskers and Wizardry demo!
notes.content:
Today the demo version 0.5.0.0 is out - and it's a good one!

I've had a lot of feedback from testers this past week and two of the major points were:

[list]
[*] The demo is a bit too easy, which means there's an issue with experiencing the power progression fully because everything dies too easy, and also it means you'll play for less time.
[*] The core gameplay of the spell crafting rune system and the feline power ups, seems really awesome and we want to lean as much into it as possible.
[/list]

On top of that they found some bugs that needs to get fixed. These are the areas I've tried to improve upon in version 0.5.0.0, which led to the following patch notes:

[list]
[*] Added rarity to runes (Common, Rare, Epic and Legendary). Only Common and Rare runes are dropped without Corruption (See below).
[*] Added a Corrupted Rune system to the core spell crafting system. 
[list]
[*] Corrupted runes are either of Epic or Legendary rarity, but they are corrupted, meaning their powers cannot be used right away. 
[*] To cleanse the corruption, you must wear the corrupted rune through a certain amount of sections.
[*] While the rune is equipped it fills a slot and it gives a buff to the enemies in the section. 
[*] The "Corruption Power" determines the amount of sections you have to have this disadvantage before being able to cleanse the rune:
[list]
[*] The Corruption Power tokens are reduced by 1 per slot rank you place the rune in. 
[*] For instance if the rune has 5 Corruption Power, you could either go through 5 sections with it equipped in a rank 1 slot, 3 sections with it equipped in a rank 2 slot or 2 secions with it equipped in a rank 3 slot. 
[/list]
[*] After cleansing you get a new powerful epic or legendary rune. 
[*] The most powerful of the existing runes are moved into the Epic category. This means that they are harder to obtain and should give players and extra challenge, raising the difficulty of the game as requested.
[/list]
[*] Added a new Enemy Power, called Ambush, which makes enemies spawn much faster.
[*] Fixed UI bugs related to certain resolutions
[*] Adjusted damage and effects done by different runes. Magic bolt, Arcane Volley and Arcane Nova all had a decrease in damage. Poisonous Impact, Deadly Dash and Retribution had an increase in damage. Speedster had an increase in % chance to reset the sequence cooldown.
[*] Adjusted the transparency for the area-markings of where attacks are landing, to have less visual clutter. This might need more adjustment, but it's an improvement from previously.
[*] Added prompts to make players confirm upgrades.
[*] Increased the damage done by Living Bomb (from the "Fire Mastery" Feline Power).
[/list]

Hope that you'll enjoy the newest demo version!

Happy gaming,

- Mathias Zillo
Zillo Games

notes.title: The demo is finally here!
notes.content:
I am super thrilled to announce that the demo for Whiskers and Wizardry is finally live!
This also means that the playtest is taken down for now - it might get up later with a more complete build when the release date is closing in.

The updates for the demo:

[list]
[*] New enemy power system: Each section provides a power for all enemies in the section. In the demo you can face 3 different powers at the moment: 
[list]
[*] Immolation Pulse: Enemies creates an explosion around them every few seconds!
[*] Speedster: Enemies move 30% faster.
[*] Self destruct: Enemies creates a large explosion when they die - watch out!
[/list]
[*] Loads of polishing, including:
[list]
[*] Better control sprites
[*] Cannot pick up items when you have a full inventory
[*] Better area of attack marks 
[*] Better performance
[*] New boss screen to make players ready for the fight!
[*] Better markers for UI navigation - making everything easier to see especially on smaller screens like the Steam Deck.
[*] Updated difficulty system and better explanations on what higher difficulties mean.
[*] Updated tooltip visuals.
[*] Updated ground graphics with more grass to feel less plain.
[*] Implemented a more suitable, easier readable font.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: From Playtest to Demo!
notes.content:
Today, I've sent my Demo to review at Valve and when that gets approved sometime next week (hopefully) I will shut down the playtest and support the Demo only.
That said, the playtest has just been updated so that it is the same as the current Demo build - this means new content for you guys and a better play experience.

[list]
[*] More levels of the forest area
[*] The camp is expanded so you can see new areas - they cannot be entered in the demo though
[*] The winter and mushroom areas are prohibited now - instead the demo is entirely played in the forest area.
[*] When defeating the final boss (which has moved to section 9) the player is now met with a little bit of story instead of just getting a win-screen.
[*] Difficulty and progression has been adjusted once more. The goal is that the demo should encourage players to play about 3 run-throughs to get enough of a taste of the game. This should equal to about 30 minutes of playtime. 
[/list]

I hope you all will go an play the demo once it comes out and leave a review :) 

Thanks for all the feedback I've received - it has helped alot on making a better game and preparing for the demo!

Happy gaming
- Mathias Zillo
Zillo Games

notes.title: Feline Powers and Difficulty Updated
notes.content:
I'm excited to share that the playtest update 0.2.0.0 is now live!
This patch is a bit bigger and gives some more things to explore and experiment with, encouraging a bit longer playtimes than previously.

[list]
[*] Revamped the Feline Power system. Now it is a talent tree where you can pick 1 of 2 talents for each level you gain. These can be redistributed for each run in the camp. The purpose of this tree is for players to feel like they get great progression, and meaningful choices that affects how they approach their builds and playstyle in each run.
[*] New Feline powers: I've added 4 brand new Feline Powers to the game. Looking for synergies? Look at the Level 4 powers: 
[list]
[*] Fire mastery: When damage from a fire based spell is triggered, the target becomes a living bomb that explodes after 3 seconds or when dying! In addition you start with the Fireball spawn rune.
[*] Poison Mastery: Each enemy infected with poison will gain new stacks when other enemies get stacks. In addition poison stacks 2 more times (to a total of 5) and you gain the Poisonous Impact rune in the beginning of your runs.
[/list]
[*] Difficulty has been adjusted, so that higher difficulties will result in enemies with higher health, faster movement, faster shooting, longer charges and higher amounts of damage.
[*] Auto-aiming for controllers has been fixed so that it doesn't prioritize environment targets over enemy targets.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha Playtest Live Now!
notes.content:
Excited to announce that the alpha playtest for Whiskers and Wizardry is now live!

The playtest is a vertical slice (think demo) of the game, but it hasn't been fully tested for a demo release yet - I hope you'll help with that :) It would be a great help if you'd try it out and provide me some data/feedback that can help me improve the game and fix bugs.

In game there's the option to provide feedback directly (for windows only), you can also help out with answering a survery with questions and finally you are able to provide questions/feedback in my [url=https://discord.gg/THEqEZYkTe]Discord channel[/url] or on the Steam page forums which I check regularly.

The playtest includes:

- A short tutorial to get you going
- A bunch of different spell runes for you to try out the innovative spellcrafting system
- Metaprogression with tome crafting and a few feline powerups
- a bunch of in-run upgrades
- 3 different biomes with monsters and a single boss fight
- Delightful cat puns ;)
